trickyParts: Storage kinds comment_block/message_block (API kind block) so an older build skips item-block rows during the roll and after rollback.
Owed state via triggers (owed_at) that only this build drains; lock order owner, item, state; the reconciler takes the item row then the state row.
React 19's onBeforeInput is textInput, which no cut or deletion fires; the composer listens to the native beforeinput so cut/paste keeps a block's id (found by the Playwright row).
Carried offsets are UTF-16 units into the trimmed body; ReadCarried converts to bytes and refuses an offset inside a character.
deviations: A pinned message block answers 400 INVALID_REFERENCE (the existing code for every unreadable reference), not a new INVALID_REF code.
The driver's negative control against the base build fails at its first block check (A1, a mention's source is now the block node), before any A7 line.
Migration seeds run in the trigger migrations 0136/0137 (after each trigger, same transaction) rather than in 0135, so no item written between 0135 and the triggers is left without a state row.
Changelog entries are changie fragments named pr2463-Added-<time>.yaml with custom Issue pr2463 (the controller's ruling), since main now folds fragments.
